texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]进入了[From.GetName]星系，并正在观察环绕恒星飞行的L星龙。

这只生物似乎迷路了，但注意到了我们舰船的存在。尽管它没有靠近，它环绕飞行的路线中现在包括了几乎是嬉戏一般的俯冲与飞掠，似乎是在向[Root.GetName]示意。
texts.en:
The [Root.GetName] has entered the [From.GetName] system and is observing the L-Drake circling the star.

The creature seems lost, but has noted our vessel's presence. While it does not approach, its circuitous route now incorporates an almost playful plunge and sweep, seemingly directed at the [Root.GetName].

label.zh: 或许我们可以与它沟通。
label.en: Perhaps we can communicate with it.

texts.zh:
奇怪的是，L-星龙对使用敌我识别系统的波长的通讯广播有很强的接收反应。

科学专员[From.GetLeaderName]开发出了一套L-星龙可以解读并乐于执行的复杂指令——这样它就不至于因为对我们的科研船感兴趣而频繁的与舰体发生冲撞了。
texts.en:
Oddly enough, the L-Drake responds well to transmissions broadcast at wavelengths usually reserved for IFF systems.

Science Officer [From.GetLeaderName] has developed a fairly sophisticated set of commands that the L-Drake is able to interpret and will happily execute - in exchange for the occasional friendly wrestling match with one of our Science Ships.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]星系内的L-星龙似乎很温顺——至少目前如此。

如果它有智慧，我们或许可以与其结盟并从中受益。
texts.en:
The L-Drake in the [From.GetName] system appears docile - for now.

If it is intelligent, we could benefit from attempting to ally with the beast.
